# Osman Emre YAYGIN — Portfolio

> Portfolio of Osman Emre YAYGIN, a learning-focused software developer crafting modern web experiences.

## About

Osman Emre YAYGIN is a software developer specializing in full-stack web development with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. He builds modern, performant, and accessible web experiences with a focus on clean architecture and continuous learning.

## Skills

- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js
- **Backend:** Node.js, Prisma, REST APIs
- **Tools:** Git, GitHub, VS Code, Vercel
- **Other:** Responsive Design, SEO, Accessibility, UI/UX
